name: DefaultClusterPopup
description: A cluster's contents: the status breakdown and its points, worst first.
signature: <T>({ cluster, size, counts, labels, noun, onZoom, onOpen }: DefaultClusterPopupProps<T>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: cluster
props.description: Aggregate cluster represented by the marker.

props.name: counts
props.description: Counts grouped by category or status.

props.name: labels
props.description: Display and accessibility labels supplied by the application.

props.name: noun
props.description: Singular and plural names used in counts and accessible labels.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called with the point the person chooses from the list (the first eight points); the map flies to it and opens its popup.

props.name: onZoom
props.description: Called with no arguments when the person presses Zoom in; the map zooms until the cluster splits.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.
